title: Holistic silhouette canary with transactional failback and session coherency
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Adds a coordinated 'silhouette' shadow-based canary workflow with transactional failback hooks and session-coherent routing. No API surface change; rollout config schema extended with 'silhouette' mode.
description:
Context and motivation: customers running multi-tenant inference asked for a canary mode that preserves session coherence for user-affine flows while allowing shadow (silhouette) traffic to validate models end-to-end without exposing partial outputs. This PR implements a first-class 'silhouette' rollout mode that: (1) routes user sessions consistently to either promoted or silhouette variants, (2) mirrors requests to silhouette instances for fidelity checks, and (3) supports transactional failback where a detected regression triggers an atomic failback and drain window.

What this changes (high-level): updates the rollout runtime controller, adds a silhouette mirror pipeline, extends the rollout policy schema, and implements a small runtime fence to ensure session affinity during hybrid canaries. No public API surface changes for customers using the standard rollout API; advanced rollout configs can opt-in to silhouette mode.

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation of silhouette routing and mirror pipeline in orchestration runtime
- [x] New rollout policy schema field: "mode: silhouette" with validation and docstrings
- [x] End-to-end unit + integration tests for session affinity and failback
- [x] Observability: added silhouette-specific metrics and tracing tags
- [x] Rollback playbook and migration notes added to docs
- [x] Manual canary rehearsal in staging performed (smoke + regression set)

Testing and validation performed:
- Added unit tests for session-coherent routing (controller tests).
- Integration tests simulate 5000-session workload with mixed deterministic tokens to validate sticky routing under scale; results attached in test artifact.
- Canary simulation harness run with synthetic traffic including latent KV-cache pressure to ensure no degradation in tail latency.
- CI: lint -> python unit -> go unit -> integration harness -> e2e smoke -> canary-sim. First CI run had a transient e2e failure (timeout flap); rerun passed.

Operational notes and rollback behavior:
- Silhouette mode requires a small additional state: per-session lease key in Redis (default TTL 10m). The controller will create leases on first request and honor them for subsequent routing to guarantee session-coherent observations.
- Transactional failback: when the policy triggers an auto-failback (metric/regression), the controller records a failback checkpoint and initiates: (1) hard traffic cut to previous variant, (2) enqueue of silhouette requests for replay into the rollback journal, and (3) alerting with playbook link. The failback is reversible via the snapshot id recorded in the journal.
- Performance: end-to-end median latency impact measured ~+0.9ms at 10% silhouette traffic; CPU/GPU throughput stable when mirror sampling <= 20%. Batching heuristics automatically reduce mirror sampling during burst.

Backward compatibility and migrations:
- Default behavior unchanged for existing rollouts. To opt in, teams must add `mode: silhouette` to rollout config and ensure the Redis lease is available in the target environment. Private deployments need a tiny DB migration note added to the installer (see docs).

Related work items: linear/ENG-2045 (rollout policy schema), ENG-2110 (session leases), incident SUP-342 used the silhouette prototype during triage.

Implementation summary (commits): see commit list.
